title: DevLake connector POC — parallel build, one acceptance campaign
description: Two concurrent POC actions; reviewed source delivery, machine evaluations, bounded operations repair, one release campaign and default finalization. Initial acceptance permits repository code work. Private launch bindings and authority remain mandatory before live operations; unresolved runtime inputs do not block independent code work. Shared-file merge checks and runtime serialization follow the versioned parallel-execution contract; source access is not capability evidence.
